series.name: Baki
series.description: A relentless young fighter enters an underground arena where strength, instinct, and survival matter more than rules.

episodes.title: The Underground Gate
episodes.description: Baki accepts an invitation to a secret arena and discovers that every opponent has something to prove.

episodes.title: No Rules Tonight
episodes.description: A street fighter challenges the arena hierarchy while Baki studies a dangerous new technique.

episodes.title: The Weight of Strength
episodes.description: Baki must decide how far he will go when victory puts another fighter's future at risk.

episodes.title: A Worthy Rival
episodes.description: An undefeated champion arrives in Tokyo looking for the only fighter who might stop him.

episodes.title: Breaking Point
episodes.description: An injury forces Baki to rely on timing and patience instead of raw power.

episodes.title: The Final Bell
episodes.description: The arena falls silent as Baki faces his rival in a battle that changes them both.

series.name: Baki Hanma
series.description: Determined to surpass his legendary father, Baki seeks increasingly impossible opponents and tests the limits of human power.

episodes.title: The Strongest Student
episodes.description: News of an impossible victory spreads as Baki begins preparing for the fight of his life.

episodes.title: Mixed Blood
episodes.description: A versatile challenger exposes the weaknesses hidden inside Baki's confident style.

episodes.title: The Prison Champion
episodes.description: Baki enters a fortress-like prison to meet a man whose fists command absolute respect.

episodes.title: Unchained
episodes.description: The prison walls become a battlefield when its champion finally accepts Baki's challenge.

episodes.title: Ancient Power
episodes.description: A discovery from another age introduces a fighter untouched by modern combat.

episodes.title: Weapons of the Present
episodes.description: Baki's allies combine their skills against an opponent who sees every strike as a curiosity.

episodes.title: Father and Son
episodes.description: A quiet dinner between Baki and his father carries the tension of an approaching war.

episodes.title: Beyond Victory
episodes.description: The long-awaited confrontation reveals that recognition may matter more than defeat.

series.name: Better Call Saul
series.description: A resourceful small-time lawyer bends rules, tests loyalties, and slowly transforms into the legal fixer everyone will remember.

episodes.title: Public Defender
episodes.description: Jimmy takes a hopeless case and discovers a shortcut that could rescue his struggling practice.

episodes.title: The Billboard
episodes.description: A publicity stunt spins out of control and brings Jimmy the attention he wanted for all the wrong reasons.

episodes.title: Fine Print
episodes.description: A promising client forces Jimmy to choose between an easy fee and a difficult truth.

episodes.title: A Better Office
episodes.description: A prestigious job offers Jimmy stability, but its rules quickly become another kind of cage.

episodes.title: The Favor
episodes.description: Mike agrees to a simple favor that draws him deeper into Albuquerque's criminal world.

episodes.title: Switch
episodes.description: Jimmy embraces a risky identity after a professional betrayal closes every respectable door.

series.name: Breaking Bad
series.description: A chemistry teacher with nothing left to lose builds a criminal enterprise and discovers how quickly power changes a person.

episodes.title: Catalyst
episodes.description: A devastating diagnosis pushes a quiet teacher toward a dangerous partnership with a former student.

episodes.title: The Formula
episodes.description: Their first product attracts attention, and an unexpected visitor threatens to expose everything.

episodes.title: No Half Measures
episodes.description: Walter makes a choice that cannot be undone while his family notices his growing distance.

episodes.title: Expansion
episodes.description: Demand grows faster than the operation, forcing Walter and Jesse to recruit unreliable help.

episodes.title: The Distributor
episodes.description: A careful businessman offers security at a price Walter may be too proud to pay.

episodes.title: Collision Course
episodes.description: Two investigations close in as Walter's double life begins to fracture at home.

episodes.title: The New Lab
episodes.description: Walter enters a state-of-the-art laboratory and meets a partner who mirrors his ambition.

episodes.title: Pressure
episodes.description: Jesse's impulsive plan threatens the fragile peace between the cooks and their employer.

episodes.title: Kingdom
episodes.description: Walter secures his position through one final calculation, but victory leaves him isolated.

series.name: Death Note
series.description: A brilliant student finds a supernatural notebook and begins a deadly contest of logic with an equally gifted detective.

episodes.title: The Notebook
episodes.description: Light discovers that a mysterious notebook can kill and decides to reshape the world in his image.

episodes.title: The Detective
episodes.description: An anonymous detective sets a televised trap and proves that the killer can be challenged.

episodes.title: False Names
episodes.description: Light hides behind careful rules while investigators search for a pattern in the deaths.

episodes.title: Second Shadow
episodes.description: A new notebook owner appears, complicating Light's plan and attracting dangerous attention.

episodes.title: Checkmate
episodes.description: The battle of deduction reaches its breaking point as both rivals risk everything on one final move.

series.name: Hajime no Ippo
series.description: A shy student discovers boxing and learns that courage is built through discipline, friendship, and one hard round at a time.

episodes.title: First Round
episodes.description: Ippo steps into a boxing gym for the first time and surprises everyone with the force of his punch.

episodes.title: Roadwork
episodes.description: A punishing training routine teaches Ippo that endurance begins long before the bell rings.

episodes.title: The Debut
episodes.description: Nerves and an aggressive opponent test Ippo during his first official match.

episodes.title: Rising Rank
episodes.description: A string of victories places Ippo on the path toward a regional title.

episodes.title: The Counter
episodes.description: Ippo faces a technical boxer whose perfect counter neutralizes his strongest weapon.

episodes.title: Champion's Heart
episodes.description: In the final round, Ippo must find strength after his body has nothing left to give.

series.name: How to Sell Drugs Online (Fast)
series.description: A socially awkward teenager launches an online drug store and learns that rapid growth creates even faster consequences.

episodes.title: Start-Up
episodes.description: Moritz turns heartbreak into a business plan and recruits his best friend as reluctant technical support.

episodes.title: User Growth
episodes.description: A marketing stunt brings hundreds of customers and the attention of a local dealer.

episodes.title: Out of Stock
episodes.description: The team scrambles to fill orders while a school event threatens to reveal their secret operation.

episodes.title: Going Global
episodes.description: International demand transforms a bedroom project into a business none of them can control.

episodes.title: Terms of Service
episodes.description: A new investor demands loyalty while the friends argue over who really owns the company.

episodes.title: Delete Account
episodes.description: Moritz attempts to erase the platform before rivals, police, and friends close in.

series.name: Pablo Escobar: The Shadow King
series.description: An ambitious smuggler builds a violent empire while journalists and investigators risk their lives to expose it.

episodes.title: The Smuggler
episodes.description: Pablo turns a small contraband route into a network that crosses borders and buys silence.

episodes.title: Silver
episodes.description: Bribes open doors across Medellin, but one honest officer refuses to step aside.

episodes.title: Lead
episodes.description: A failed negotiation unleashes violence and forces the government to respond.

episodes.title: The Candidate
episodes.description: Pablo seeks political legitimacy while a reporter gathers evidence of his past.

episodes.title: Extradition
episodes.description: A new treaty threatens the cartel and turns Pablo's private war into a national crisis.

episodes.title: The Search Bloc
episodes.description: A specialized unit follows a fragile trail through safe houses and frightened informants.

episodes.title: No Safe City
episodes.description: As allies disappear, Pablo retreats deeper into the empire he created.

episodes.title: The Last Rooftop
episodes.description: The search ends in Medellin, leaving a country to confront the cost of the cartel years.

series.name: Sex Education
series.description: An anxious student and his fearless friend create an unofficial advice clinic for classmates navigating love, identity, and growing up.

episodes.title: The Clinic
episodes.description: Otis accidentally gives useful advice and Maeve sees the beginning of a profitable partnership.

episodes.title: Mixed Signals
episodes.description: Their first clients need more than quick answers, while Otis struggles to follow his own advice.

episodes.title: Open Secret
episodes.description: Rumors about the clinic spread through school and place an unexpected friendship under pressure.

episodes.title: New Term
episodes.description: A new semester brings new relationships, old insecurities, and competition for the clinic.

episodes.title: Honest Answers
episodes.description: A school-wide panic forces students to confront misinformation and ask better questions.

episodes.title: The Message
episodes.description: One unheard voicemail changes the course of Otis and Maeve's friendship.

episodes.title: Uniform
episodes.description: A strict headteacher promises order at Moordale and immediately clashes with its students.

episodes.title: Untold Stories
episodes.description: The friends discover how much they have hidden from one another during a difficult school trip.

episodes.title: Growing Apart
episodes.description: As Moordale faces closure, its students choose what to preserve and what to leave behind.

series.name: The Cage
series.description: A gifted amateur fighter enters the brutal world of professional mixed martial arts and risks everything for a championship chance.

episodes.title: The Open Mat
episodes.description: Taylor interrupts a champion's training session and earns a painful chance to prove himself.

episodes.title: Fight Camp
episodes.description: A veteran coach rebuilds Taylor's technique while financial pressure follows him into the gym.

episodes.title: First Contract
episodes.description: Taylor signs for a dangerous short-notice bout against an opponent with everything to lose.

episodes.title: Cut Weight
episodes.description: The hardest battle happens before the fight as Taylor pushes his body past a safe limit.

episodes.title: Center of the Cage
episodes.description: Under the brightest lights of his career, Taylor must trust the team that carried him there.
